column1: # The pinned native-wire request set (DRY-3). ONE source of truth, read by all
# three consumers so a fixture, a Rust assertion and a TS assertion can never
#   - `just snapshot-native`  regenerates <name>.json from a live engine
# Format: <name>\t<uri>. Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored.
# EVERY date is pinned. fixtures/sample.journal ends 2026-07-04, so 2026-07-08
# is "today" for it — the same as-of the e2e clock and nativeLive.integration.
# test.ts already pin. Nothing here may fall back to the server's system clock,
# or the committed bytes would change tomorrow.
